title: From RL Papers to Framework Code: Inclusion and Review in Seven Open-Source Training Frameworks
author: Taiheng Pan

summary: Practitioners use reinforcement learning methods for language models through training frameworks, so a method that a framework includes is one configuration change away for its users. We trace seven open-source frameworks for RL post-training through their commit histories and link them to 6,939 screened arXiv papers from January 2025 to June 2026.
takeaways: We trace seven open-source frameworks for RL post-training through their commit histories and link them to 6,939 screened arXiv papers from January 2025 to June 2026.
Both gaps hold without papers from the companies that maintain the frameworks, while code release was equally common in both groups.
Of 1,598 papers that propose a general RL training method, 37 reached at least one framework.
